text.title: Tegallalang Rice Terrace, Ubud Palace and Ubud Market
text.intro: We can enjoy a scenic view at Tegallalang Rice Terrace, explore Ubud Palace’s traditional architecture, and browse the colourful stalls at Ubud Market.

attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace (Viewpoint & Scenic Cafe)
attractions.description: We can take in the rice terrace from the viewpoint and enjoy the scenic café.

attractions.name: Ubud Palace
attractions.description: We can explore this former royal residence at the heart of Ubud, with its ornate gateways, carved stonework and traditional courtyards—a compact introduction to Balinese royal architecture.

attractions.name: Ubud Market
attractions.description: We can browse colourful stalls with woven baskets, textiles, carved pieces, jewellery, artwork and small souvenirs. The market is directly across from Ubud Palace.
